CustomField.description: 1. This field is used by Reps to navigate to OTTO and view their domain's Invoice data. 1202636412362996 2. When domain_id__c is set to negative number (representing pending request for domain) should not display this link. (https://app.asana.com/1/15793206719/project/1209391763425740/task/1211197106005125?focus=true) 3. For Gov Acc redirect to gov page https://app.asana.com/1/15793206719/project/1209391763425740/task/1211457336061686?focus=true
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(domain_id__c)), NOT(LEFT(domain_id__c, 1) = '-') ), HYPERLINK( IF(ISPICKVAL(DomainType__c, 'Asana Gov'), "https://otto.asanagov.biz/domain/" & domain_id__c, "https://otto.asana.biz/domain/" & domain_id__c ), domain_id__c ), "" )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Use this link to navigate to OTTO and view Invoice data for your Account. Please populate the Account's Domain ID to see a URL.
CustomField.label: OTTO Link
